title: Nakagin Board Light Kit Semantic Kinds
description: Wire nakagin-capsule-tower.board.json to metabolism.kit.light.compose.json: nodeKind per piece type, handleKind per connector port, meta.kindCatalogs for all kit node kinds and family port handle kinds; update generator and Board.story merge.
summary: Nakagin board fixture now carries metabolism light `nodeKind` on every node and `handleKind` on every handle (from connector port.handleKind), with `meta.kindCatalogs` listing all light kit node kinds (id=nodeKind, label=name) and Nakagin family port handle kinds (id=handleKind, label=port name, HSL color, defaultWireKind). Generator reads layout from full metabolism.kit.compose.json and semantics from metabolism.kit.light.compose.json (families under initialKit). Added mergeBoardKindCatalogBundleByRowId, boardFixtureMetaKindCatalogBundle, parseBoardFixtureV1 nodeKind, BoardFixture nodeKind on circle+rectangle. Storybook Nakagin story and board play merge fixture catalogs into WASM defaults. @elements/board tests passed.
